ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: This development version uses the local network to look up products through the server on your Mac.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used only on your device to calculate distance to the nearest recycling point. It is not saved or uploaded.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used to read barcodes and photograph products. An image is sent for identification only after your separate approval.
